description: Exportlab connects ChatGPT to a photographer or videographer's studio workspace so users can review projects, clients, galleries, videos, contracts, proposals, and notifications; update workspace records; prepare unsent document drafts; manage review feedback; and update selected public-facing gallery metadata, profile text, and project status pages.
